caseNameFull: Harry Michelsohn v. Charles F. Dittmar, as Trustee, etc.
attorneys: Mr. David H. Bilder for petitioner. Mr. James D. Carpenter, Jr., and Mr. John M. Enright for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for a writ- of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the *739Third Circuit denied because of failure to file the petition within the time prescribed by the statute.

Mr. David H. Bilder for petitioner. Mr. James D. Carpenter, Jr., and Mr. John M. Enright for respondent.
